author: claude-design
scope: Exported static geometry, buffer/index/normal validity, embedded images and texture links, revised system control/tag/reference bindings, 13 actual vertex motion samples per revised gun/sensor clip, small focused case-exit ray grids, exported lower-30-base/support vertices against the retained source skin, and aircraft-independent source rebuilds.

focused_case_exit_probes.scope: Nine rays start inside the exported cavity and cross its mouth into a short receiving corridor. Cases and effects are excluded so they cannot masquerade as an uncut wall. Not a full-body sweep, opening-truth verification, or operational cycle certification.

focused_lower_30_skin_probe.method: At each exported vertex Y,Z, project original exterior triangles along X and compare vertex X with the outermost negative-X intersection. Positive margin is inboard.
focused_lower_30_skin_probe.scope: Only the fixed 30 mm inboard base and its two lower supports. No other airframe mechanism, animation sweep, triangle-interior clearance, real aircraft dimension or operational fit claim.

files.image_and_reference_scope: Images decoded and texture references checked; reference metadata presence checked, not factual source truth or material realism.
